description: Election Commission - A. A. Renuka was elected as the member of the Vavuniya Orban Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Vavuniya Urban Council) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member to fill the vacant seat. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for local authorities.
